sentences.en: Rename operations no longer spuriously try to create links.

sentences.en: The lawyer argued spuriously that his client knew nothing of the burglary.

sentences.en: Some spuriously exact statistic, such as 65, 000 or 31% or 0.1, is dressed up with mights, coulds and other pseudo-qualifications.

sentences.en: The date may be spuriously precise, but the danger is there.
sentences.vi: Ngày tháng có thể chính xác một cách khó hiểu, nhưng nguy hiểm là ở đó.

sentences.en: These figures were often spuriously computed by selecting particularly favorable sample groups.

sentences.en: In this case, it might spuriously influence the specificity of the association between vaccine and adverse event.

sentences.en: The developers solve (or spuriously solve) their bugs and give back the new source to me .
